display_long_description:
**AUDION** is an abstract, single-player arcade-style VR game focused on “spatial strategy” and fast-paced, physical gameplay. Think Asteroids meets Rez meets Geometry Wars in 3D. 

Currently in **Early Access**, so we're looking for passionate players to help give us feedback so we can improve, tune, debug, and upgrade the game to be as fun as possible. To join as a playtester and get access to the entire game, join our Discord server (link below) to get access. If you enjoyed this demo, please leave us a nice rating/review and wishlist!
[media]
**AUDION** Highlights:
- Immersive, first-person, physical gameplay
- Focus on spatial awareness and strategy
- 2 frenetic song levels of increasing difficulty and complexity
- Each level has 3 difficulties and an Infinite game mode
- Smash or Repel IONs on the musical downbeat for mults
- Powerup load-out feature for strategic gameplay combinations
- Abstract geometric aesthetic pulse with audio-reactive graphics
- Electrifying soundtrack by Symbion Project that builds as you play

[media]

- Menus and tutorials localized into both English and Japanese
